title: mcp/get_review/v1
description: The result of the get_review tool (F26-T10, R3, R14; D-9, D-28 v3.39): GET /reviews/<id>, body for body — a target's formalization review as the records under targets/<id>/review/ hold it at main's head, with the state derived by the gate's own module (opn_gate.review, the derivation the products carry) and the candidates under the blind rule: to a caller with no candidate of their own on the record (no token, or a token whose identity authored none) every candidate's lean is null with lean_withheld blind; once the caller's candidate is merged, every Lean is shown. The words, cases, questions and answers are contributor text, so the answer carries the untrusted note. Or an error result: 404 review-unknown for a target with no review, target-unknown for no such target, or the source that did not answer (R10).

read_at.description: The commit of main the graph was read at, or the branch name when the service could not learn its head (F05-T13).

caller.description: The pseudonym of the bearer the blind rule was applied to; null for an anonymous read.

blind.description: Whether every candidate's Lean was withheld: true until the caller's own candidate is on the record.

review.description: review.yaml (review/v1): the opening — who opened it in which role, the day, the words, the cases, the concepts, the source, the tracking issue.

state.description: The derived review object targets-index and graph.json carry (F26-R17): state (none, open, needs-intent-signer, complete), candidates, surviving, clusters, questions_waiting, open_pairs, grade_cap, signers by role, tracking.

candidates.description: Every candidate/v1 record, each with its Lean under the blind rule.

read_others.description: The author's declaration, shown as the claim it is (F26-R3); null where none was made.

lean.description: The candidate's Lean, or null while withheld.

lean_withheld.description: blind while the Lean is withheld by the blind rule; null when shown.

tests.description: Every intent-test/v1 record (the case, the probe, the expected result and its source).

questions.description: Every review-question/v1 record, each with `waiting`: true while no answer names it.

answers.description: Every review-answer/v1 record: the intent signer's answer, its cited source or null, the login, signed by the approval key.

pairs.description: Every pair/v1 record: each direction proved, refuted or open with its exhibit or attempt.

open_pairs.description: Each open direction (a, b, direction), as graph.json publishes them (F26-R8).

exhibits.description: Every exhibit/v1 record the gate wrote: a kernel-checked result (a screen, a test, a pair direction, a mutant), the stage-3 evidence.

signatures.description: Every review-signature/v1 record: a signer's decision by role, signed by the approval key.

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
